title: Integral finite models of a finite etale cover after shrinking
statement:
Let $C$ be an integral Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], where Noetherian means admitting a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $U\subseteq C$ be a nonempty affine open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $g:T\to U$ be a finite etale surjective morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism]. There exist a nonempty affine open $W\subseteq U$, a nonempty finite index set $A$, integral schemes $Y_a$ and finite morphisms $q_a:Y_a\to C$ for $a\in A$, such that $V_a=Y_a\times_CW$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a nonempty open subscheme of $Y_a$, and there is an isomorphism of $W$-schemes
$$T\times_UW\ \cong\ \coprod_{a\in A}V_a.$$
In particular the whole inverse image of $W$ in $\coprod_aY_a$ is identified with $T\times_UW$, not merely with an open subscheme thereof.
